rubric.formula: rank_product = cognitive_distance x structural_generativity x mechanism_concreteness (each 1-5)
rubric.adjacency_policy: adjacency to prior work is NOT a penalty (R10). Only hallucination/regurgitation could remove a construct, and none were flagged.
rubric.note: M056 ranks below the top tier because of distance(2 top-domains)/generativity scoring, NOT because of its close prior work — that adjacency was explicitly disregarded per R7/R10.

ranking.merged_construct: Haggling Reward Model (reservation-probing critic that concedes)
ranking.rationale: haggle + Kalman + RLHF -> belief-state reward model that actively probes/concedes; per-skill covariance; over-optimization alarm. 3 alien domains, novel RLHF.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Probabilistic Uncertain Reward Model (PURM, arxiv 2503.22480) and Bayesian Non-negative Reward Model (BNRM, arxiv 2602.10623) -- uncertainty-aware RMs using distribution overlap/covariance to flag over-optimization. Conceptually adjacent on the uncertainty axis but passive, single-agent, no active-probing/bargaining inversion; context only.

ranking.merged_construct: Frustrated Marinade Routing: spin-glass diffusion-depth allocation for mixture-of-experts under grudge-weighted gating
ranking.rationale: spin-glass + marination + grudge -> frustration-energy MoE router with a glassy AGING signature (two-time correlation) absent in top-k. Maximal distance, deep, measurable.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: MoE routing framed as a congestion game with mean-field limit; 'Three Phases of Expert Routing' load-balance evolution (arxiv 2604.04230); Latent Prototype Routing (arxiv 2506.21328). Physics-of-MoE adjacency only; the spin-glass-frustration + grudge-coupling + marination-depth combination is not present.

ranking.merged_construct: Fermentation-Memory Probing: many-body-localized starter lineages for measuring non-thermalizing memory in long-context models, gated by tip-of-the-tongue retrieval
ranking.rationale: MBL + sourdough lineage + tip-of-tongue -> a localization-length for in-context memory + a sharp phase transition with a tunable disorder knob (RoPE base).
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: MBL memory literature (LIOMs, imbalance, log-entanglement) is the physics source; no work transfers it to LLM long-context memory. Adjacent only as the borrowed metric.

ranking.merged_construct: Vector-Clock Stage Fright: causal-ordering model of evaluation-induced performance collapse under observation
ranking.rationale: vector-clocks + stage-fright + yawn-contagion -> causal-DEPTH law for eval-induced behavior change (sandbagging depends on causal distance, not just the cue). Safety.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Sandbagging/eval-awareness research (arxiv 2508.00943, 2505.14617 Hawthorne effect) is the real adjacent target; uses CoT/probes, not vector-clock causal ordering or contagion dynamics.

ranking.merged_construct: Persistent-Homology Bruise Forensics: topological dating of when a capability or backdoor entered a model lineage
ranking.rationale: persistent homology + bruise-dating + tree-rings -> topological DATING in time via a barcode over a checkpoint filtration; flags load-bearing-yet-young (backdoors). Safety/audit.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Neural Persistence (arxiv 1812.09764) and filtration-learning TDA on nets -- static/representation-shape analysis, not checkpoint-timeline dating of backdoors. Adjacent tool, distinct application; does not disqualify.

ranking.merged_construct: Anti-Conformist Steering (fashion-cycle vectors that abandon common directions)
ranking.rationale: fashion-cycle + contrarian -> state-dependent self-abandoning closed-loop steering vs fixed vector; 3 alien top-domains; diversity gains.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Stiefel/STARS activation steering for diverse generation (arXiv:2601.22010) and selective-layer diversity restoration (arXiv:2602.06665). These target mode-collapse/diversity but are not closed-loop self-abandoning controllers with projection-EMA feedback and sign-flip hysteresis. Context only.

ranking.merged_construct: Kinship-Inference Mode Connectivity (resemblance-based lineage of trained models)
ranking.rationale: family resemblance/lineage -> alignment-FREE permutation-invariant markers that PREDICT mode-connectivity barriers without the expensive alignment search.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: MoTHer / Unsupervised Model Tree Heritage Recovery (arXiv:2405.18432) reconstructs model trees from weights; Ghost in the Transformer / GhostSpec (arXiv:2511.06390) uses per-layer singular-value spectral fingerprints for model-reuse detection. Both overlap with M019's lineage + invariant-fingerprint components but neither ties the fingerprint to mode-connectivity BARRIER prediction or soup-compatibility. Strong adjacency, CONTEXT only — does not flag.

ranking.merged_construct: Fishing-Rod Speculative Decoding: patience-budgeted draft casting with a self-knotting backoff
ranking.rationale: fishing patience + knot -> explicit log law k*=ln(c/V)/ln(p_hat) + geometric throughput identity; position-varying optimal draft length. Very concrete/practical.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: AdaEDL (entropy lower-bound on acceptance prob for early draft stopping, arxiv 2410.18351), SVIP (self-verification length policy via draft entropy, arxiv 2411.18462), SpecDec++ (trained acceptance head + threshold stop, arxiv 2405.19715). All adaptive-draft-length-via-acceptance; adjacency only, not identity.

ranking.merged_construct: Emulsion-Stability Consensus: fluctuation-dissipation surfactant alignment for averaging fine-tuned models under impostor-discounted contributions
ranking.rationale: FDT + emulsion + impostor -> FDT line (marginal soup effect linear in weight-space fluctuation) + curdling trust score for model merging.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Model soups (Wortsman 2022) and greedy/learned soup weighting; none uses fluctuation-response theory. Adjacent target, distinct mechanism.

ranking.merged_construct: Bloom-Filter Tip-of-the-Tongue: false-positive partial-recall sketch as a model's calibrated 'almost-knows' signal
ranking.rationale: Bloom filter + tip-of-tongue + deja-vu -> one-sided no-false-negative abstention primitive + a 2x2 recall-state typology. 2 top-domains -> CD=4 (NOT penalized for adjacency).
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: arxiv 2602.00906 'Hallucination is a Consequence of Space-Optimality: A Rate-Distortion Theorem for Membership Testing' -- formalizes LLM memorization as membership testing and generalizes the Bloom-filter bound to log-loss. CONTEXT ONLY; it is an impossibility theorem, not this construct's activation-sketch + TOT/deja-vu method. Does not disqualify.

ranking.rationale: algal bloom-crash -> per-concept gradient-noise-scale trajectory; forces an early-warning lead-time (2nd moment precedes 1st). 2 top-domains.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Gradient Noise Scale (McCandlish et al., arXiv:1812.06162) and follow-ups on per-example/per-layer GNS (arXiv:2411.00999) — these compute GNS but globally, with no ecological bloom-crash trajectory or per-concept early-warning. Context only; does not disqualify.

ranking.merged_construct: Natal-basin homing with directional growth record (salmon-moss mode connectivity)
ranking.rationale: salmon homing + moss growth-record -> mode-connectivity 'climb compass' that DECODES the alignment permutation. Elegant equivalence crossing-cost=alignment.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Git Re-Basin (arXiv:2209.04836), Optimizing Mode Connectivity via Neuron Alignment (arXiv:2009.02439), REPAIR (arXiv:2211.08403). All compute alignment then measure barrier; none records climb direction as a compass. Context only.

ranking.merged_construct: Feature Reputation Field (gossip-derived identity for dictionary features)
ranking.rationale: gossip/reputation -> a third-person feature identity (reputation embedding) independent of decoder direction; cross-hop reputation variance.
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Feature Monosemanticity Score (FMS) and MonoScore (arXiv:2506.19382 and related). Both quantify monosemanticity but via classifiers / individual-dimension analysis, not via a relational gossip-reputation fixed point. Adjacency only; does NOT disqualify a genuine merge.

ranking.merged_construct: Junk-Drawer Mixture-of-Experts: the default-absorber expert and lid-mismatch routing audit
ranking.rationale: junk-drawer catch-all -> confidence-gated absorber expert + logistic fill ODE early-warning. Catch-all<->expert is somewhat intuitive (CD lower).
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: Confidence-thresholded self-activating experts and low-confidence-token routing analyses (Expert-Choice routing, research.google; counterfactual routing arxiv 2605.07260); MoE representation collapse (arxiv 2204.09179). Adjacent only; no named 'absorber expert with logistic fill law + lid-mismatch entropy exponent'.

ranking.merged_construct: Sock-Drawer Attention Sink: the unmatchable-singleton reservoir and its accumulation law
ranking.rationale: odd-sock reservoir -> context-length GROWTH LAW for attention-sink mass (concave). Strong law but parents close (both domestic).
ranking.nearest_prior_work_CONTEXT: StreamingLLM single learnable sink token; attention-sink-as-stabilizer analyses (emergentmind, ICLR 2024); softmax-flattening fixes (Scalable-Softmax arxiv 2501.19399; Softplus re-weighting arxiv 2501.13428). Adjacent; no named 'sink-mass accumulation law vs length with rank-sized multi-slot sink'.
